overview.title: Question Bank & Assessment Core
overview.lede: This increment turns the Sprint 1 learning foundation into governed graded assessment. It deliberately separates question existence from question trust: only approved items can enter graded forms.
overview.goal: Author → Review → Approved bank → Blueprint → Equivalent forms → Reliable attempt
overview.statBankNote: Questions carrying topic, difficulty, marks, language and an immutable source.
overview.statReviewNote: Human review required. An instructor cannot approve their own item.
overview.statAttemptsNote: Timer, answers, attempt limit and form version are server-authoritative.
overview.step1Body: Instructors author. A content reviewer or academic admin approves or rejects. Draft and in-review items never leak into graded use.
overview.step2Body: A graded assessment uses a standard topic, difficulty, type and marks blueprint. It is not personalised per student.
overview.step3Body: Students may receive equivalent forms, but the server owns the timer, item order, answers and submit state.
overview.decision: Product decision: personalisation belongs to practice and revision. Graded session quizzes, course exams and diploma finals share one approved blueprint with deterministic equivalent forms.

bank.title: Question bank
bank.lede: Create traceable questions and keep provenance visible. Metadata is required before an item can be saved.
bank.goal: Complete metadata before save • provenance is immutable
bank.importNote: Bulk import sits outside this reference build.
bank.boundary: Boundary: source is visible and immutable after creation. Editing the wording does not rewrite whether an item was human-authored or AI-generated.
bank.sourceNote: Source will be recorded as human-authored and cannot be rewritten later.
bank.metadataRequired: Topic, difficulty, marks and language are all required before saving.
bank.answerCorrectHint: Must match the option text exactly.
bank.answerOptionsMin: Add at least two options before saving.
bank.answerCorrectMissing: The correct option(s) must match the option text exactly.
bank.answerModelMissing: Add a model answer before saving.
bank.answerNumericMissing: Add a correct numeric value before saving.
bank.answerRubricMissing: Add a grading rubric before saving.
bank.empty: The bank is empty. Add the first question to start building a blueprint.
bank.tableCaption: Questions in the bank with their metadata and review status

review.title: Review queue
review.lede: Human approval controls graded eligibility. Only a content reviewer or academic admin can approve.
review.goal: Draft → In review → Approved / Rejected / Retired
review.eligibilityNote: A blueprint may be saved while items are still under review, but graded assembly must fail if the approved bank cannot satisfy it.
review.approved: Question approved — now eligible for graded use
review.denied: This role cannot approve items. Switch to content reviewer or academic admin.
review.empty: The queue is clear. Nothing is waiting on a reviewer.

builder.title: Assessment builder
builder.lede: Define the assessment type and a complete graded blueprint. Practice and graded types intentionally follow different rules.
builder.goal: A graded assessment cannot publish without a complete blueprint
builder.integrityBody: All graded forms inherit the same topic weights, difficulty distribution and total marks.
builder.equivalence: Different students may receive different equivalent forms and shuffled order. That is equivalence, not personalised grading.
builder.tableCaption: Item counts required per topic and difficulty
builder.personalizedLockedGraded: Graded assessments never personalize content — this is locked to No.
builder.cannotAssemble: This graded assessment cannot assemble yet.

reason.no_topics: Add at least one topic to the blueprint.
reason.weight_sum: Topic weights must add up to 100%.
reason.empty_topic: Every topic needs at least one item across easy/medium/hard.
reason.total_marks: Set the total marks for this assessment.

assembly.title: Equivalent form assembly
assembly.lede: Run a deterministic assembly from approved items only. A failure names the exact bank gap; nothing is silently substituted.
assembly.goal: Same blueprint + approved bank + seed → repeatable equivalent forms
assembly.gapBody: No in-review or draft item was substituted. Add or approve enough eligible questions, then run assembly again.
assembly.tableCaption: Equivalence checks across the assembled forms
assembly.empty: No forms yet — run assembly to generate the equivalent set.

attempt.title: Student attempt
attempt.lede: Exam runtime with a server-owned timer and answer persistence. Refreshing the browser does not create a second truth.
attempt.goal: Server owns timer • item order • answers • attempt count • submit state
attempt.submitted: Attempt submitted — an immutable version was recorded
attempt.tampering: Tampering: changing a client-side timer or score is ignored and logged as a security event.
attempt.disconnectBody: Previously saved answers remain on the server. The server timer keeps running.
attempt.reconnected: Reconnected — no saved answer was lost
attempt.timeUp: Time is up. The server closed this attempt.

work.title: Quiz and assignment placement
work.lede: Assessment work appears at the correct academic level. One quiz definition per session at most; assignments may live at session, course or diploma level.
work.goal: The parent context is visible to instructor and student
work.attached: Attached — now visible with its status

security.title: MFA and access audit
security.lede: Privileged admins get stronger authentication, and denied access stays traceable.
security.goal: Academic admin and system admin require MFA
security.enrollmentBody: Academic admin and system admin must supply a valid time-based code after their password.
security.deniedBody: Every sensitive 403 decision is auditable by user, source and outcome.
security.mfaBody: Password accepted. {{role}} requires a second factor: enter the time-based code from your authenticator app to finish switching.
security.mfaHint: Demo build — enter 246810 to simulate a valid authenticator code.

practice.title: Practice quiz
practice.lede: Practice draws from items that haven't cleared review yet — including AI-generated drafts. It is never graded, and every screen says so.
practice.goal: Unapproved items only • never enters a graded score
practice.label: Practice — not graded
practice.empty: Nothing to practice with right now — every item has cleared review.
